name: Thumb Sprint
tagline: Mash on your phone. A friend in the next lane from one link. No race server.
description:
Mash the pad on your phone. Your sticker sprints. First across the tape wins. A friend sits in the next lane from one invite — there is no race server.

Jump the countdown and everyone sees it: you lurch, you go back, you wait. The last second of the race loops so you can see whose nose broke the tape.

On your own, race a ghost of your best run, or a computer with a fair cadence — beatable if you mash, not asleep if you don't. Close the app: your best time is still there.

The pad is most of the lower half of the phone. On a laptop, hit space.
